title: Kanom Krok with Cabbage and Aromatic Spices
description: A delicious Indian-inspired street food dish featuring crispy rice cakes with cabbage and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped aromatic and sauté until fragrant.
Add shredded cabbage and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Prepare the kanom by toasting them lightly in a pan.
Assemble the dish by placing a toasted kanom on a plate, topping with a spoonful of the cabbage mixture, and finishing with a sprinkle of ko.
